mike_cs: FYI the TideCart team just escalated — after yesterday's canary they started getting SKU strings cut mid-token in generated order summaries. customer attached a few examples. can we triage? :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary rollout v2.4.0 -> us-west-2 completed at 2024-06-15T22:14:00Z (rolled to ~10% traffic)

mike_cs: example customer excerpt they sent (redacted):
```
Request ID: req-xtZ-abc123
Model: redwood-v1-medium
Prompt: "Summarize order: [items list with SKUs]"
Response (truncated): "...items: [\"TIDE-XL-23A\", \"SEA-DRP-5"
```
they say it used to return full SKUs and now some responses drop the trailing chars or end with an odd quote.

devon_se: thanks. first ask: can we get the exact request/response logs (prompt + tokens + final text) for req-xtZ-abc123? if customer can't share raw PII, ask for the raw payload but redacted only carrier-specific data — we need exact whitespace and system/user content. also confirm whether they used streaming + batching.

mike_cs: customer says they used streaming=true and a batch size of 8 through our hosted API. attaching the minimal example they provided (they agreed to share):
